title: Dendrocopos major
author: Vladimir Yu. Arkhipov, Arkhivov
changes: Great spotted woodpecker (Dendrocopos major) drumming on a tree in the Kaluga region, Russia: one fast drum roll. Trimmed to 8.20–9.60 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 0.8 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
